office_does: The Prosecuting Attorney prosecutes criminal actions in superior, district and juvenile courts and provides legal advice to the county.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Christy Peters (Prefers Democratic Party), chief of staff of the Prosecuting Attorney's Office, is the only candidate on the ballot and has no prior elected experience, so the office will change hands.

candidates.summary: Longtime deputy prosecutor and the office's chief of staff since 2011, running unopposed for Prosecuting Attorney.
highlights: Chief of staff of the Prosecuting Attorney's Office since 2011; deputy prosecutor from 1995 [S1]
Would prioritize violent crime and crimes against children and strengthen victim advocacy [S1]
Helped expand therapeutic Drug, Veterans and Mental Health Courts [S1]
